messages.subject: Sound Classification & Pattern Recognition
parts:
I'm a Ph.D. - Pediatric , BUT i do have some programming knowledge mysql/php and some linux Commands :). 

i'm looking to recognize "baby crying sound" in order to know the baby needs.
We need it to deal with the sound as an event, not as music.

I did record a lot of baby crying sounds and identify each sample with the "baby status" , is he / she hungry , tired..etc. to train the system

Situation :

= A baby start crying , and we need to identify / analyze the sound/
= Mother will hold an Mobile Device to record a sample of the crying sound. 30 sec of crying sound.
= The sample will be sent to a "Linux" server to be fingerprints.
= Fingerprints will be compared with "Our collected database" form the hospitals to be categorized.
= Server will return the "Best matched records with the matching percentage" category name to the mobile.

i found echoprint.me lib , but it wont do this, cos it relies on very precise and repeatable timing in pre-recorded music.

some of people advice me to use speech recognition , like http://cmusphinx.sourceforge.net , but since crying sound is not belong to phonetics category then cmusphinx won't help.

i found www.findsounds.com/palette.html and i test it , it may be the best option for me but it is not an opensource app, thy do provide an APIhttp://www.comparisonics.com/api.html but Comparisonics API restricted only to large organizations.

can  seewave help with this ??

Please advice.
